exposure: Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) administration during pregnancy
cohort: Nine pregnant women with a high viral load (HBV DNA >=5.3 log IU/mL) who received tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF) at approximately 28 weeks of gestation.
finding: NA administration was highly effective against mother-to-child transmission of HBV in pregnant women with high HBV DNA levels, but hepatitis flares were commonly observed after NA discontinuation in the postpartum period.
followup_time: Up to 6 months after TDF discontinuation for mothers and during infancy for infants.
